name: Florentine
source:
“...Huh? Are you all seriously making fun of me?”

Unit: Offense Black, 1st Squad
Rank: Baggage

A girl who serves as a vanguard soldier in the Ruined World.

Her rough speech and brash attitude are her trademarks, and she enjoys chasing pleasure. She is honest with her emotions and charges straight ahead without any thought.

Because her temperament is thoroughly immature, she sometimes loses even to opponents she should easily overpower in a simple contest of strength.

Class: Physical Type
Reality-Altering Ability: Draconic Girl — an ability that infuses the power of a dragon into her body. With raw physical strength and overwhelming endurance, she crushes her enemies through sheer force.
